info.name: LJVIS — Vehicle/Trailer Technical Check Forms
info.description: Functional tests for /control-forms/{vehicle-technical|trailer-technical} endpoints (LJVIS2-72). Covers permission boundaries (vehicle_technical_form.write/read, trailer_technical_form.write/read, control_form.edit_locked), backend validation (compoundFormKey required, notes max length, trailer-exclusion of vehicle-only codes), version/status lifecycle (saved -> confirmed, the saved-state no-version-bump rule, already_confirmed, and the edit_locked-gated re-save of confirmed/published data), and the X-tee fields block. Self-contained: authenticates and creates its own compound form + sub-forms.
